description: Figure 6, titled "Data source distribution of combined training and AttrEval-Simulation sets," is a pie chart that illustrates the proportion of data from different sources within the combined training and AttrEval-Simulation datasets. The chart is divided into five colored segments, each representing a distinct data source with its corresponding percentage. The largest segment is orange, representing TRIVIAQA, which accounts for 22.7% of the data. The second-largest segment is blue, representing ENTITYQUEST, at 26.0%. The red segment, representing HOTPOTQA, makes up 24.2% of the distribution. The yellow segment, representing POPQA, contributes 21.6%. The smallest segment is a very thin green slice, representing TREC, which constitutes 1.9% of the data. A small light blue segment, labeled WEBQUESTIO, accounts for 3.6% of the total. Each segment is clearly labeled with its source name and percentage value.
